entities.summary: Harri Lorenzi is a Brazilian agronomic engineer and writer on trees of the Atlantic Mata. He is a collaborating agronomist of the garden of Fazenda Cresciumal, Ruy De Souza Queiroz. He published four books in the late 1990s: Brazilian palms, Brazilian Trees, Tropical Plants of Burle Marx and Brazilian Ornamental Plants.
